name: praxis
description: Gestão de compras corporativas — do pedido ao pagamento

scripts.testar-unidade: node --test tests/unidade.test.mjs tests/textos.test.mjs tests/functions.test.mjs tests/sistema.test.mjs tests/pwa.test.mjs
scripts.testar-e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-praxis-e2e "node scripts/seed-emulator.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e.test.mjs tests/celular.test.mjs"
scripts.medir-desempenho: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-praxis-e2e "node scripts/seed-emulator.js && node scripts/medir-desempenho.mjs"
